heading: Rohit Addanki — a journey of determination & growth
intro: From background artist to lead actor to entrepreneur — the story driving Rohit Media Works, as covered in the press.

profile.name: Rohit Addanki
profile.title: Actor · Co-Producer · Media Entrepreneur
profile.bio: Starting his career as a background artist, Rohit Addanki steadily carved his path in the Telugu entertainment industry through dedication and perseverance. From supporting beginnings to lead roles in popular serials like Attarintiki Daaredi, Devatha and Rangula Ratnam, he proved his screen presence and versatility. He went on to feature in notable films including Major, Ghost and the N.T.R. Biopic, along with the acclaimed web series Three Roses. Expanding beyond acting, Rohit has stepped into co-production and OTT acquisitions, dubbing rights and syndication — successfully selling close to 17 Telugu films into Hindi and North Indian markets. From artist to entrepreneur, he continues to grow as a dynamic force in cinema.
